name: webhooks
changelog: v1: public webhook URLs (a token or GitHub-style HMAC) that run the triggers of the agents this tile is bound to
title: Webhooks
description: Public webhook URLs for your agents: GitHub, a CI, a monitor or anything that can POST reaches /hook/<id> (checked by a token or an HMAC signature), and each delivery runs the matching triggers on the agents this tile is bound to — as outside data, so only triggers allowed to take it run.
